scope: Two controlled synthetic current-view questions; desktop Chrome; configured vision model; no historical-view feature

success_criteria.answers: Both answers identify the exact image-only code and instruction; question contains neither answer
success_criteria.requests: Exactly one chat POST per user question; no background image upload
success_criteria.isolation: Usage event reports one current frame and zero history frames; transcript API contains no image data URLs or observation packets
success_criteria.budgets: Each estimate is at or below the advertised input cap, with positive output reserve
success_criteria.lifecycle: Keyboard-accessible start/details/reset/stop; thread change and reload expire source evidence
success_criteria.measurement: Report capture setup, encode preparation, request-to-first-token, and total time separately; unknown upload/provider split stays unavailable
success_criteria.latency_hypothesis: Warm encoding below 250ms is a candidate target, not a measured guarantee. Two samples cannot establish p95 or general accuracy.
